description: Adspirer connects your Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and TikTok Ads accounts to ChatGPT so you can manage advertising in plain language. Review connected accounts and campaign performance, research keywords and targeting, audit conversion tracking, draft new campaigns and creatives, and set up scheduled reports and threshold alerts. New campaigns are always created paused for your review, and budget, bid, or status changes are made only when you explicitly ask — nothing goes live without your confirmation.
